cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Told You Enough
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest while repeatedly narrowing what honesty requires and which details count.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'll be honest about my birthday. When you rang, I was eating dinner alone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your brother posted a photo from our kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. He came for dessert. By dinner, I mean the main course.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's beside you while you're carving the chicken.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Carving isn't eating. I meant the moments when food was actually in my mouth.

mechanism: A lectures a partner on exact terms to defend a claimed honest account of eating alone against photographic evidence.
confusable: A plain lie is confusable; repeated narrowing of dinner and eating must be audible after each challenge.
comparison: Intimate distrust and a photo differ from bookkeeping questions about a donation.
seedUse: Use main-course and carving distinctions without the standard wrapper; preserve observable contradiction as A's evasive lie.
